# The licences the libraries bundled in midgie's JAR may carry, checked against target/bom.json by
# .github/scripts/check-licences.py in CI. The list is what the JAR shipped when the check was introduced
# (midPoint 4.11.0, 2026-10-26), not a statement that anything else is forbidden: its job is to make the
# next new licence, usually arriving with a midPoint bump, fail the build until someone has looked at it.
# Adding a line here is that look: check the licence lets midgie, under EUPL-1.2, redistribute the
# library inside its fat JAR.
#
# Licences, as SPDX identifiers, one per line:
Apache-2.0
BSD-3-Clause
BSD-4-Clause
MIT
EPL-2.0
LGPL-2.1-only
GPL-2.0-with-classpath-exception
EUPL-1.2

# Libraries whose POM declares no licence, so the SBOM has none to check, with the licence established by
# hand: a group:artifact pattern ('*' matches anything), then that licence, which must be listed above.
#
# midPoint, prism, axiom and Evolveum's commons are EUPL-1.2 (midPoint's LICENSE; prism-api's MANIFEST.MF
# says "EUPL-1.2 or later"), but their POMs carry no <licenses> block.
com.evolveum.*:*  EUPL-1.2
